title: Marlowe & Finch Cardmember Goodwill on Registry Price Protection — Merchandise Purchases
content:
A registrant claiming registry price protection on a Merchandise Purchases unit receives card goodwill according to the cards held in the Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards program:

- holding an active **Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite or World Elite Mastercard** — the premium protection card goodwill, **$10.00**;
- holding **any other active Marlowe & Finch card** — the cardmember protection card goodwill, **$5.00**.

The first line governs whenever it holds, even alongside other cards. A registrant holding no active Marlowe & Finch card is outside this goodwill.

| Active cards on record (hypothetical) | Goodwill |
|---|---|
| World Elite Mastercard | $10.00 |
| Store Card and Store Card Elite | $10.00 |
| Mastercard only | $5.00 |
| none active | outside this goodwill |
